description: This file contains a shell script designed to test the behavior of the 'git checkout' command when dealing with ambiguous references such as branches and tags. It sets up test scenarios with ambiguous refs and verifies the correct handling and output messages.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets up prerequisites for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Grep test outputs for specific patterns.
